history.period: 20th century (modern branch of the Nanaksar samparda - verify; exact construction date not published)
history.summary: THIS IS A SIKH GURDWARA, NOT A HINDU TEMPLE. Gurudwara Nanaksar Sahib, Ludhiana is the Ferozepur Road branch of the Nanaksar samparda, located at Canal Bridge opposite Punjab Agricultural University (Sarabha Nagar, Block K), in Ludhiana city - NOT the central Nanaksar at Kaleran near Jagraon (~30 km away), which is the head dera of Baba Nand Singh Ji (d. 1943, live samadhi in the Sutlej), succeeded by Sant Ishar Singh. The Nanaksar tradition emphasises Naam Simran and simple meditative devotion; distinctively, no monetary offerings are placed before the Guru Granth Sahib. A YouTube devotional channel identifies the Ferozepur Road branch's mukh sewadar as Sant Baba Jagir Singh Ji (verify) and records its Janam Dehda celebrations of Baba Nand Singh. AMBIGUITY FLAG: several 'Nanaksar Sahib' gurdwaras exist in and around Ludhiana (Ferozepur Road/PAU branch, Samrala Chowk branch on Grand Trunk Road, Nanaksar at Jagraon, Nanaksar Kaleran) - the generic CSV name could refer to more than one; this file documents the Ferozepur Road (opposite PAU) branch, which best matches the CSV's 'Ludhiana' town, with corroboration from the geocoder hit (Nanaksar Gurudwara, Ferozpur Road, Block K, Sarabha Nagar) and the Justdial listing (Canal Bridge, Opposite Pau, Ferozepur Road, Ludhiana-141001). Coordinates are therefore a corroborated approximation (verify).

name: Gurudwara Nanaksar Sahib
town_description: Ludhiana is Punjab's largest industrial city, set on the Grand Trunk Road along the old course of the Sutlej. This Nanaksar Sahib stands on Ferozepur Road at Canal Bridge opposite Punjab Agricultural University, in the Sarabha Nagar area of Ludhiana city (PIN 141001/141008), a well-connected urban stretch near the city's central districts.

travel.airport: Sahnewal Airport (Ludhiana) has limited service (verify); nearest major airport is Sri Guru Ram Das Ji International Airport, Amritsar (~135 km) or Chandigarh (~100 km).
travel.railway: Ludhiana Junction (Delhi-Amritsar line); Ferozepur Road branch is ~5-7 km from the station (verify) by auto or taxi.
travel.road: On Ferozepur Road at Canal Bridge, opposite PAU, Sarabha Nagar; easily reached by city buses, autos and taxis.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March for pleasant weather; Baba Nand Singh's Janam Dehda and Guru Nanak's Gurpurab for major congregations (crowded).
visitor_information.opening_hours: Justdial lists 04:00 am-10:00 pm daily for the Ferozepur Road branch (verify); the separate Samrala Chowk Nanaksar branch is listed as open 24 hrs - do not confuse the two. Cover your head and remove shoes before entering.
